decision_basis: The direct cohort shows useful gains, but does not establish the predeclared acceptable overall tradeoff. Consistent adverse no-live short-large warm-turn wall observations and additional cold lifecycle increases remain. Rejection is a conservative retention decision, not proof that the cached-SELECT code caused a population-wide regression.
predeclared_rule: Adopt only if the direct cohort supports useful gains without a consistent material wider regression; otherwise revert the narrow production change while retaining its evidence.
threshold_note: No numeric materiality threshold was predeclared; no new percentage cutoff or workload weighting is imposed after seeing results.

reader_review.verdict: No arithmetic or identity regression found in two-cohort adaptation. Diff only changes description, cohort names and removes inapplicable cross-engine identities.

reader_review.scope_limit: The reader validates recorded semantic-oracle outcomes, not a fresh semantic implementation. Manifest hashes identify the recorded binaries; it does not itself hash executable files or verify source-build provenance. This audit separately hashed both executable files and matched build identity documents; source-build provenance remains the recorded verified build evidence. Unused Pi branches/constants are inert in this two-cohort reader.

uncertainty_and_scope: All three pairs, all six cases and both observation modes are retained; no failed or adverse observations removed.
Each interval uses only3 process-pair ratios, df2 log-t90% (upper endpoint also one-sided95%), and is not corrected for searching many metrics. Narrow auxiliary intervals do not prove code causation.
